forecast_convention: Day-ahead: every hour of day D is predicted from information available at 09:00 IST on day D-1. Weather inputs are archived day-ahead forecasts, never observations.

hot_period.definition: Research-defined: population-weighted national daily maximum day-ahead forecast temperature >= 37.67 C (the p90% of daily maxima over the training period). NOT an India Meteorological Department heatwave declaration.

extrapolation.note: A gradient-boosted tree predicts a weighted average of training leaf values, so a level-target model cannot exceed the maximum demand it saw in training. The delta-target model predicts the change from the previous day's same hour and adds that anchor back, so it follows load growth beyond the training range.

weather_contribution.comparison: lgbm_weather vs lgbm_calendar_history (identical algorithm, hyperparameters and delta target; only the feature set differs)

significance.note: Computed on daily mean absolute error to reduce the effect of hour-to-hour error autocorrelation. Positive improvement means the weather model has lower error.

evening_ramp.definition: Research residual load = metered all-India demand (NLDC_DEMAND|P) minus SCADA all-India solar (clipped at 0) and wind. Not an operator net-load definition; excludes behind-the-meter solar, interchange and storage.

evening_ramp_full_period.definition: Research residual load = metered all-India demand (NLDC_DEMAND|P) minus SCADA all-India solar (clipped at 0) and wind. Not an operator net-load definition; excludes behind-the-meter solar, interchange and storage.

rolling_backtest.scheme: expanding window, monthly refit, out-of-sample month scored
